info.title: SMK Ghama Caraka - Attendance API
info.description:
Backend API for SMK Ghama Caraka School Attendance System (Sistem Absensi Sekolah).

Provides structured RESTful endpoints for attendance tracking, role-based workflows, and reporting.

tags.name: Siswa
